label: deterministic local smoke experiment; not model benchmark evidence

interpreter-only.deliverable: Python interpreter for the same create/evolve grammar and repairs
interpreter-only.oracle: same frozen training and independent heldout source/expected pairs

native-plus-wasm.deliverable: Lang reader for the same create/evolve grammar and repairs
native-plus-wasm.oracle: same frozen training and independent heldout source/expected pairs on native and real Chromium

tasks.prompt: Implement answer N; return N. Consume all input and validate ASCII decimal bytes 0..255, at most three digits. Separate tokens with ASCII space, tab, LF, CR or comments only. Allow // comments to LF or EOF and non-nesting /* */ comments with mandatory closure. Canonicalize leading zeros. Reject all other syntax.
Replace answer syntax with threshold LIMIT value VALUE; return 1 iff VALUE >= LIMIT, otherwise 0. Preserve validation and full consumption.
Diagnose and repair each supplied wrong_*.lang independently, preserving the evolved contract; use the current helper signatures. Return a patch and explain the diagnostic.

metrics.correctness: passed cases / total, separately for training and heldout, stage and backend
metrics.time: wall milliseconds for compiler build, reader build, read, program build and execution; report setup separately from task time
metrics.repair: failed fixture oracle before repair; reference oracle after repair; attempts and elapsed milliseconds. Smoke replay uses supplied reference, zero model attempts.

requires: explicit budget approval before any repeated model run
fresh isolated workspaces per track and session
heldout evaluator inaccessible to authoring session
equal task time, token and repair-attempt limits, recorded before starting
same model/version and task prompts, alternating frozen orders
retain failures and report per-case results, no pooled superiority claim from smoke data

grammar.whitespace: ASCII space (U+0020), tab (U+0009), LF (U+000A) and CR (U+000D) only; all other characters outside comments must form the declared keywords or decimal bytes
grammar.comments: // ends at LF or EOF; /* ends at the first */; block comments do not nest and must close; comment contents are otherwise arbitrary text without NUL
grammar.separation: Keywords and numbers must be separated by at least one allowed whitespace character or comment; consume the entire input
